name: Minakami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minakami town emblem in blue: a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a wave or mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Minakami, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 March 2008.

features.role: Minakami town emblem — a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a wave or mountain
